blocking_findings.defect: The exact future SUPERVISOR_CLOSED event and completion-receipt preimage are circular, so the final close event is not deterministically precomputable and recovery cannot be executable as frozen.

For example, exclude close_event_payload_sha256 and all close-event-derived values from the preimage hash bound by SUPERVISOR_CLOSED; deterministically derive the close payload/event from that immutable preimage hash; then let the post-close receipt bind the immutable preimage plus the actual closeout head.
